text: bhikkhakasuttaṃ [716] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . atha kho bhikkhako brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhikkhako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca ahamasmi bho gotama bhikkhako bhavampi bhikkhako idha no kiṃ nānākaraṇanti . [717] na tena bhikkhako hoti yāvatā bhikkhate pare vissaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya bhikkhu hoti na tāvatā yodha puññañca pāpañca pavāhetvā 1 brahmacariyaṃ saṅkhāya loke carati sa ve bhikkhūti vuccatīti . [718] evaṃ vutte bhikkhako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama .pe. upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti . ekādasamaṃ
